messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

For radar target/echo testing, the supported instrument role is a radar echo generator such as R&S AREG800A, which provides dynamic artificial object generation for radar under test workflows [38].
For FMCW radar, AREG800A’s digital echo generation sets the minimum generated distance to the radar-under-test air gap value and supports a maximum generated distance of 3000 m [38].
AREG800A can generate artificial objects with distance ranges such as ≥ air gap to 3000 m, depending on options and frontend combinations [39].
AREG800A supports individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, with velocity settings up to ±500 km/h when configured with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-B63 [48].
A signaling tester such as R&S CMX500 is documented as a one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing [5].
CMX500 also provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput measurement and PER measurement [3].
In OTA workflows, CMX500 OBT is documented as integrated into MVG WaveStudio so MVG antenna measurement systems can run 5G NR and LTE OTA signaling tests [11].
MVG’s broader test solutions include antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation and electromagnetic measurements [12].
A non-signaling CMX500 GPRF Generator can generate ARB, CW, dual tone or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay/creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [1].
The CMX500 IQ recorder can record IQ data to a file, save `.wv` files for replay and inspect the recorded trace in the GUI [2].
【推論】In a radar workflow, the signaling tester would fit only as an adjacent communications/OTA validation block, not as the radar echo/target simulator, because CMX500 is documented for cellular/WLAN signaling while AREG800A is documented for radar echo generation [3][5][38].
【推論】The non-signaling tester could fit earlier in RF waveform replay or TX-check steps around a radar-related RF chain, because the CMX500 GPRF Generator supports ARB/CW/dual-tone/`.wv` replay and standalone TX measurement, but the passages do not tie that CMX500 use directly to radar [1].
【推論】For the radar-specific part of the workflow, AREG800A would sit at the radar-under-test stimulus/echo-simulation stage, while CMX500 would sit in separate communications signaling or non-signaling RF validation stages if those are part of the system test plan [1][3][38].

passages.text:
CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › Rear panel interfaces
- LAN：Ethernet RJ-45 connector，1000 Mbps。
- Trigger interfaces：Trig. A、Trig. B，2 × BNC connector，3.3 V TTL；Trig. C、Trig. D、Trig. E，3 × BNC connector，3.3 V TTL；AST Out，1 × BNC connector。
- Flexx Sync interface：for future use；In 為 1 × mini SAS HD connector；Loop 為 2 × mini SAS HD connector；Out 為 1 × mini SAS HD connector。
- Flexx Data interface：for future use；In/Out 各 1 × QSFP-DD connector。
- Flexx IQ interface：for future use；In/Out 各 1 × QSFP-DD connector。
- LAN Switch Subnet Only interface：for future use；port 1、port 2 各 1 × SFP+ connector。
- USB：for keyboard、mouse、USB flash drive；2 × USB 3.1 type A connector。
- HDMI：for external monitor；DisplayPort：for external monitor。

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B300C processing unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B300C]] 需要 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]] option，提供 generic high-performance computing platform for advanced data processing。Interfaces：

For radar target/echo testing, the supported instrument role is a radar echo generator such as R&S AREG800A, which provides dynamic artificial object generation for radar under test workflows [38].
For FMCW radar, AREG800A’s digital echo generation sets the minimum generated distance to the radar-under-test air gap value and supports a maximum generated distance of 3000 m [38].
AREG800A can generate artificial objects with distance ranges such as ≥ air gap to 3000 m, depending on options and frontend combinations [39].
AREG800A supports individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, with velocity settings up to ±500 km/h when configured with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-B63 [48].
A signaling tester such as R&S CMX500 is documented as a one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing [5].
CMX500 also provides NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput measurement and PER measurement [3].
In OTA workflows, CMX500 OBT is documented as integrated into MVG WaveStudio so MVG antenna measurement systems can run 5G NR and LTE OTA signaling tests [11].
MVG’s broader test solutions include antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation and electromagnetic measurements [12].
A non-signaling CMX500 GPRF Generator can generate ARB, CW, dual tone or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay/creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [1].
The CMX500 IQ recorder can record IQ data to a file, save `.wv` files for replay and inspect the recorded trace in the GUI [2].
【推論】In a radar workflow, the signaling tester would fit only as an adjacent communications/OTA validation block, not as the radar echo/target simulator, because CMX500 is documented for cellular/WLAN signaling while AREG800A is documented for radar echo generation [3][5][38].
【推論】The non-signaling tester could fit earlier in RF waveform replay or TX-check steps around a radar-related RF chain, because the CMX500 GPRF Generator supports ARB/CW/dual-tone/`.wv` replay and standalone TX measurement, but the passages do not tie that CMX500 use directly to radar [1].
【推論】For the radar-specific part of the workflow, AREG800A would sit at the radar-under-test stimulus/echo-simulation stage, while CMX500 would sit in separate communications signaling or non-signaling RF validation stages if those are part of the system test plan [1][3][38].

- 整合後支援 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 表示，[[MVG]] 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。

依 [[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]]：

- [[MVG]] 已將 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓 manufacturers 可在 single antenna measurement system 中執行 comprehensive 4G、5G 與 [[WLAN]] [[OTA testing]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合 full Wi‑Fi（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）access point and station testing functionality。
- Software now supports [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing with the [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[MVG]] multiprobe measurement systems 被描述為 fully support Wi‑Fi and cellular standards，包括 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD），all within a single tester。

MVG › 來源中的公司描述
依 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]] 與 [[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]]：

- [[MVG]] 的全名為 Microwave Vision Group。
- 提供 cutting-edge technologies for visualizing electromagnetic waves。
- 其 advanced test solutions 用於 antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements。
- 支援 company R&D teams innovate and boost product development。
- 營運於 10 個國家。
- 90% sales from exports。
- Group revenues exceeding €100 million。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S AREG800A › Artificial objects
| Frontend 組合 | Distance condition | Maximum artificial objects |
|---|---|---:|
| with [[R&S QAT100]] | `< 4 m to 3000 m + air gap` | 最多 8 個；4 m 至 17 m 最多 4 個，17 m 至 3000 m 最多 4 個 |
| with [[R&S QAT100]] | `> 17 m to 3000 m + air gap` | 最多 8 個 |
| with [[R&S QAT100]] | `≥ air gap to 3000 m` | 最多 8 個 |
| with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]] or [[R&S FE44S]] | `< 4 m to 3000 m + air gap` | 最多 32 個，每 frontend 最多 8 個；4 m 至 17 m 最多 4 個，17 m 至 3000 m 最多 28 個 |
| with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]] or [[R&S FE44S]] | `> 17 m to 3000 m + air gap` | 最多 32 個，每 frontend 最多 8 個 |
| with [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]] or [[R&S FE44S]] | `≥ air gap to 3000 m` | 最多 32 個，每 frontend 最多 8 個 |

其他 artificial object 規格：

- Object distance accuracy with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] option：`±5 cm (meas.)`。
- Object distance step size with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] option：`1 cm`。
- Air gap：object distances 與 resulting object radar cross-sections 會依 frontend reference plane 與 DUT 之間距離改變；來源建議 air gap 足夠大以符合 radar under test 的 far-field condition。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
- Base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth 依 option 為 `1 GHz`、`2 GHz` 或 `5 GHz`；overrange 分別為 `1.2 GHz (meas.)`、`2.2 GHz (meas.)`、`5.2 GHz (meas.)`。
- AREG800A base unit IF frequency range：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`；來源另列 [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`，但 5 GHz bandwidth ordering information 顯示還涉及 [[R&S AREG8-K528]]，此處未自行推論修正。
- RF frequency bands：[[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] 為 `24 GHz to 24.25 GHz`；[[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 與 [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]]、[[R&S QAT100]] 為 `76 GHz to 81 GHz`；[[R&S FE44S]] 為 `24 GHz to 44 GHz`。
- 每台 [[R&S AREG800A]] base unit 支援 conventional mmWave frontends 最多 4 個，[[R&S QAT100]] 最多 8 個，[[R&S FE44S]] 最多 8 個 external frontends（4 個 TX、4 個 RX，共 4 pairs）。
- Artificial object distance 可依 option 涵蓋 `< 17 m to 3000 m (meas.)`、`< 4 m to 3000 m (meas.)`、`≥ air gap to 3000 m (meas.)`；production frontend 組合列為 FMCW `≥ air gap to 350 m (meas.)`，non FMCW `< 17 m to 350 m (meas.)`。
- Radial velocity：每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift；with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]] velocity setting range 為 `±500 km/h`，velocity step size 為 `0.001 km/h`。
- Remote control interfaces 包含 Ethernet 與 [[R&S AREG8-K986]] GPIB；remote control command set 為 `SCPI`。
- HiL interface option 為 [[R&S AREG8-K109]]；open-standard protocol support 為 open simulation interface（OSI）；time synchronization protocol 為 `gPTP`、`NTP`。
- Base unit `AREG800A` Order No. `1437.4400.02`，包含 power cable 與 quick start guide。
